# American Library Association

> The American Library Association (ALA) is the premier professional organization for librarians, providing membership, conferences, publications, advocacy, and community resources for the library profession.

ALA serves as the central hub for library professionals across the United States, offering member portals, annual conferences, divisional organizations, and publications like American Libraries. The organization advocates for library services, manages elections, and hosts major events including the annual conference and National Library Week celebrations.

## Membership & Community

- [American Library Association](https://www.ala.org): ALA homepage with membership information, awards, publishing, and conference details
- [ALA Connect Member Portal](https://connect.ala.org/home): Member portal for discussion, collaboration, and resource sharing among ALA members
